scope: Active P1/P2/P3 only. For this medtech device issuer, report active pivotal / IDE clinical studies of company's own devices (per task rule for device companies).

website.note: Corporate site lists products only (CapsoCam Plus, CapsoCloud, CapsoView). No dedicated /pipeline page (404).

ctgov.note: Single legacy 2018 PHASE1 study (NCT03685903) with status UNKNOWN; not active and not for current commercial pipeline.

indications.indication: Colonic polyp detection / colorectal cancer screening
indications.trial_name: CapsoCam Colon Pivotal Study - Second Arm
indications.trial_design: Prospective, open-label pivotal study comparing 2nd-gen CapsoCam Colon capsule endoscopy to optical colonoscopy; planned ~800 patients at up to 20 U.S. sites; AI-assisted vs non-AI-assisted reading; primary endpoints sensitivity/specificity for polyps >=6mm.
indications.trial_status: Enrolling - over 500 of ~800 patients enrolled as of 2026-03-26 10-K
key_milestones: First-gen CapsoCam Colon 510(k) effort discontinued after Dec-2025 FDA meeting; resources reprioritized to 2nd gen

indications.indication: Visualization of small-bowel mucosa with AI-assisted polyp/abnormality detection
indications.highest_phase: Pivotal (device, FDA 510(k) pathway) - retrospective clinical study supporting filed 510(k)
indications.trial_name: CapsoCam Plus AI retrospective clinical study
indications.trial_design: Retrospective clinical study analyzing in vivo videos from completed real-world cases to assess AI performance for small bowel; predicate device NaviCam ProScan.
indications.trial_status: Ongoing - supports 510(k) submission filed 2025-12-26; FDA clearance targeted mid-2026; EU submission Q2 2026

products.name: CapsoCam Plus (SV-3)
products.status: FDA-cleared (small-bowel mucosa visualization, adults and pediatric ages 2+); marketed in U.S. and internationally via distributors. 2025 revenue ~$13.6M.

products.name: CapsoCloud / CapsoView
products.status: Cloud and viewer software supporting CapsoCam Plus.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: PHASE1 study, status UNKNOWN since 2020; not part of active pipeline.
Company has decided not to further pursue first-generation CapsoCam Colon 510(k); resources redirected to 2nd-generation capsule.
